previous_statement: There is a universal kappa >= 0 and a universal threshold e_sq > 0 such that, for every H-CB datum with e <= e_sq, every n >= 1, and every Z in M_n tensor S_P, one has ||Z^dagger dot Z|| <= (1+kappa*e)||Z||^2.
new_statement: The allowed inputs establish the square estimate ||Z^dagger dot Z|| <= (1+kappa_1*e)||Z||^2 only at level n=1 (apart from the trivial zero-corner case). They do not establish any universal kappa and threshold for all M_n tensor S_P uniformly in n. Hence the original amplified square estimate, and therefore the root proof through node 1.2, is not proved in this dependency scope; an additional amplified-corner norm theorem is required.
